run_detection_scores_cli: run the CLI to compute machine translation detection scores on a dataset using NLLB, COMET, LaBSE, LASER, XNLI, or SONAR
compute_nllb_alti_scores: compute ALTI mean, ALTI contrast, and log loss scores for MT detection using an NLLB model checkpoint
compute_optimal_transport_scores: compute attention-based optimal transport detection scores by comparing attention maps against a reference pickle file
compute_comet_qe_scores: compute COMET-QE automatic MT quality estimation scores using the wmt20-comet-qe-da-v2 model
compute_multilingual_embedding_scores: compute LaBSE, LASER, XNLI, or SONAR embedding-based similarity scores for source and machine-translated text pairs
